title: Physician Assistants meet primary care
summary: In the PAAM project, physician assistants (PAs) are integrated into future GP team practices. In the first six months, the PAs undergo intensive training specific to GP practices, and the practice teams, including the PAs, receive approximately monthly coaching over a period of 1.5 years to promote interprofessional cooperation.
conditions: Physician assistants (PAs) are to be integrated into GP practices in the project. The aim is to investigate how interprofessional practice teams can work together effectively and trustfully in future collaborations in order to master the challenges of the future.

interventions.name: The intervention practices employ a physician assistant in their practice for a period of 18 months.
Practices that were randomized to the control group continue to work without employing a PA and receive no other intervention (care as usual).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Criteria for GP practices to participate as a study cluster
PA: Completed Physician Assistant studies with a Bachelor's degree by the time of recruitment (no later than 31.12.2025). Willingness to work full-time or part-time with at least 50% job scope.
General practitioner practices: in a region with a coverage rate < 100% according to the information provided by the participating Kassenärztliche Vereinigungen Westfalen-Lippe and Schleswig-Holstein. If not enough GPs are reached with this restriction, GPs in a region with a coverage rate ≥ 100% can also be included in a second step.

Criteria for interviewing practice staff as part of the primary data collection
All physicians and medical assistants of the included control and intervention practices who have consented to participate in the surveys.

Criteria for interviewing patients as part of the primary data collection
All patients of the included control and intervention practices.

Inclusion criteria for the secondary data analysis by the Zi
All patients who were treated at least once in one of the participating practices during the observation period.
Inclusion criteria for the secondary data analysis of BARMER patients
All patients insured with BARMER who were treated at least once in one of the participating practices during the observation period.

Inclusion criteria for the secondary data analysis of AOK patients (via WIdO)
All patients insured with an AOK who were treated at least once in one of the participating practices during the observation period.
Exclusion criteria:
Criteria for GP practices to be excluded as a study cluster
PAs: who already work in a GP practice and wish to remain in their employment.
GP practices: in which a PA or an MFA who is studying to become a PA is employed.

Criteria for the exclusion of practice staff as part of the primary data collection
none

Criteria for the exclusion of patients as part of the primary data collection
Minors or patients who are acutely or chronically incapable of giving consent

Exclusion criteria for secondary data analysis by the Zi
none

Inclusion criteria for the secondary data analysis of BARMER patients
none

Inclusion criteria for the secondary data analysis of AOK patients (via WIdO)
none
